naamp_primary.qualifier: small effect; one of two prespecified sensitivities narrowly crosses zero

independent_support.broad_claim: recent rainfall is associated with greater event-level multispecies calling overlap in both standardized NAAMP and independent FrogID recordings

directionally_consistent_but_not_validat.rule: primary beta < 0 but frozen support_rule_pass == false
directionally_consistent_but_not_validat.wording: FrogID is directionally consistent but does not independently validate the NAAMP rain effect

null_or_ambiguous.rule: primary beta confidence interval includes 0 without frozen support

contradictory.rule: primary beta > 0 and two-sided p < 0.05 with CI excluding 0
contradictory.wording: independent FrogID evidence points in the opposite direction

mechanism_boundary.interpretation_if_external_support: shared weather activation can synchronize event-level calling overlap without detectable pairwise network densification

prohibited_post_result_actions: do not change FrogID sample fraction
do not change dry-day cap or transform
do not switch to rainfall amount if dry-spell validation fails
do not select a state/month/recorder subset for validation
do not replace primary with a sensitivity analysis
